title: Context set manifest frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of a *.context.md manifest. Carries the Prometheux config and points at pristine body files. Note identity = (manifest, referenced path); duplicates are allowed and surfaced, never deduped.

scope.description: Declared here, NOT inferred from the folder.

activation.description: retrieved (semantic pool) | always (=rule, injected every request) | on_demand (title listed, body fetched on demand).

kind.description: Default kind for notes in this set, e.g. fact.

chunk.description: single note vs document-chunk. 'auto' decides by size/type.

notes.description: Body files referenced by this set. A string is a path with set defaults; an object overrides per entry.

links.description: Authored links only; derived_from is platform-owned and never written here.
